upstream.draftTitle: Built-in lint pins unsupported Semgrep1.34.1 and excludes suffixed Dockerfile targets
upstream.draftBody: AI-assisted investigation at CLI2.102.23 found the wrapper selects returntocorp/semgrep1.34.1 with dynamic p/dockerfile. Retained cloud and local controls miss a selected missing-user rule; a pinned1.181.0 scanner detects it. The new image also requires /usr/bin/semgrep rather than the old absolute path. A disposable source candidate updates the image, executable and --scan-unknown-extensions. Fourteen mount-free/network-none2CPU/2GiB command-boundary controls verify missing-user positives, USER-present/no-command negatives and matched current-engine flag omissions. The original/patched argument vectors are extracted from actual source. Full RunImage BuildKit gateway behavior, ignored process Wait error and fragmented-output capture were not qualified, so this draft does not claim the complete integration was repaired. No current Semgrep engine bug or human verification is asserted.
